notes: Hong Kong Observatory rainfall-rate imagery: one rendered frame every six minutes, 256 km range, rainfall rate at 3 km. A rendered product, not a volume, so the engine publishes the Observatory's image with the ground box from the Observatory's own KML ground overlay and the Observatory's own band edges, and never resamples its pixels (docs/radar-fetch.md). The station is the Observatory's weather radar on Tate's Cairn; the product's ground overlay places the picture's centre within 2.6 km of it. Non-commercial use with attribution, per the Observatory's Intellectual Property Rights Notice.
